playstyle: The grappler. Wavu calls his throw game the strongest of all: make the opponent block, then throw them with command throws that each break differently. Mix throws with mids and lows so they cannot just duck or break. His big body, slow movement and weak panic options make defence hard, so take the initiative.

stances.name: Jaguar Step
stances.entry: From dashes and transitions (see the Move Library)
stances.note: JGR.1+3 is an unbreakable throw and Heat Engager; in Heat Jaguar Step becomes armoured and its moves are powered up (Wavu).

keyMoves: To make crouchers respect mids before you throw.
Mid check that sets up throws.
Body Check: i17 mid, +3 on block.
A plus mid that keeps the turn.
To keep pressure before a throw.
Jumping Knee Lift: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
After -15 moves and to whiff punish.
Toe Smash: i11 while-standing kick, -6 on block.
Snap Uppercut: i18 while-standing launcher, -10 on block.
After lows that are -18 or worse.
Leg Breaker: i32 low that instantly tornadoes, -12 on block.
As a read on standing block.
Block low; it is slow enough to react.
Shoulder Tackle: i20 mid Heat Engager, -5 on block.
Giant Swing: i10 command throw, break with 1, side switch.
A big-damage command throw (homing in Heat).
Tijuana Twister: i12 command throw, break with 2.
Muscle Buster: i11 command throw, break with 1+2, side switch.
Tomahawk: i10 throw from a run, break with 1+2.
A fast running throw (homing in Heat).
To catch the opponent from a dash.
